title: Novonix
summary: Australian-American maker of synthetic graphite anode material and battery-testing equipment.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Novonix produces synthetic graphite anode material and supplies battery-testing equipment from facilities in Canada and the US. Synthetic anode can be tuned for fast charging and longevity, and the company is positioning for US local-content requirements. Commercial-scale output and customer contracts are still developing.

Technology Exposure

  • Synthetic graphite anode material
  • Battery testing equipment
  • US anode capacity

What To Watch

  • Customer offtake agreements
  • Plant ramp and yields
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
